COMPOSITION IDEA: one compact square jigsaw assembly is the main mass. It consists of eight connected pieces in a simple 3-by-3 arrangement, with its CENTER piece conspicuously missing. This central piece-shaped empty opening is the visual focus, with real transparent negative space through it. All adjoining puzzle seams should meet coherently around that opening. The loose matching piece has wandered out of its central place and is now relaxing, casually LEANING against the lower-right OUTER edge of the assembly, slightly tilted, wearing a tiny pair of sunglasses. The board edge supports it like a backrest; the piece has an ordinary rigid puzzle shape, no human body, limbs or face. It should read as 'the missing piece is off duty', not as a new character portrait. No separate deck chair. The piece and the big assembly touch physically and share one coherent viewpoint, so they read as one designed scene rather than two floating illustrations. The loose piece is the same size and interlocking silhouette as the center opening, allowing for its rotation. Do not invent a mismatched second hole.

SQUARE DESIGN: near-frontal shallow orthographic perspective, minimal consistent edge thickness, a strong quiet near-square outer silhouette. Center the main assembly; the small lounging piece breaks its lower-right contour just enough to deliver the joke. Roughly a 3-to-1 width relationship between the assembly and the single piece. The complete scene fits within the middle 80–85% of a SQUARE 1:1 canvas. Balanced air on all sides. The central opening must remain completely readable. No cropped contours, no excessive transparent padding and no split upper-left/lower-right diagram layout.

STYLE: preserve refined fine warm-charcoal contours, light off-white puzzle surfaces, controlled natural pen character, very sparse interior lines. Make the loose missing piece a very pale muted terracotta, the only color accent; tiny sunglasses in warm charcoal. Very restrained flat material, tiny necessary side-edge planes only; no rendered 3D, glossy shading, fuzzy halo, soft fog, gradient, texture, heavy outlines, drop shadow or decorative rays. Entire background and the center opening truly transparent. Legible when displayed at 240px square.
Only the jigsaw assembly, its missing piece and the sunglasses. No other props, chair, furniture, ground scene, paper, documents, cow, horse, robot or human. No words, numbers, error code, labels, buttons, UI, logo or watermark.
